To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a method to georeference UAV images directly from GPS data.
the UAV photogrammetry can be an efficient tool for civil engineering applications.
• We have developed a method to georeference UAV photogrammetric images.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following points: 1/ Theoretical analysis of the direct georeferenced photogrammetry. 2/ Experimental validation of this technique with low cost equipments. 3/ Development of a dedicated software to perform the direct georeference. 4/ Application of the technique to earthworks.

- the use of a UAV for photogrammetric surveying, - the use of an embedded low-cost GPS for the georeferencing, - the development of a specific processing chain adapted to the UAV and GPS constraints.
the development of a low cost photogrammetric tool for the calculation of earthworks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed methodology is a reliable tool for earthworks surveying and that it can be used as a complementary solution to traditional methods.
the use of a low-cost camera and GPS receiver on a UAV for the photogrammetric restitution of a 3D point cloud is a very efficient tool for civil engineering.
the proposed method allows to obtain accurate georeferenced ortho-images.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
it is not possible to perform a direct GPS georeferencing for a low cost camera.

the use of a UAV for the acquisition of images and the use of a low-cost GPS receiver for the georeferencing is a very promising solution for the calculation of volumes of stock and the monitoring of sites.
we are able to perform a direct geo-referencing on a set of images taken by a low-cost camera and a low-cost UAV.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the accuracy of the GPS receiver is not sufficient to achieve a georeferencing with an accuracy better than 0.5 m.
the accuracy achieved with this low-cost equipment is sufficient to perform the required measurements.
it is possible to obtain a good accuracy in positionning and orientation of the UAV, even with a low-cost equipment.
